title: Emergency (green corridor)
description: One emergency vehicle run. The operator starts it, the route is computed from intersection neighbours and every intersection on the route is given green in turn. Proposed format - none of this is in the SRS yet. Proposed endpoints: POST /api/emergencies (body: #/$defs/startRequest), GET /api/emergencies/active, POST /api/emergencies/<id>/clear. Proposed Socket.IO events: emergency_update (#/$defs/emergencyUpdate) and emergency_cleared (#/$defs/emergencyCleared).

id.description: Unique emergency id, assigned by the backend.

start_id.description: Intersection where the vehicle enters the corridor.

end_id.description: Intersection where the vehicle leaves the corridor.

route.description: Intersection ids in travel order, from start_id to end_id inclusive.

current_id.description: Intersection the vehicle is at or approaching; null once cleared or cancelled.

status.description: active while the corridor is running; cleared when the vehicle has passed end_id; cancelled when the operator stops it early.

started_at.description: When the operator started the emergency (ISO 8601, UTC).

cleared_at.description: When the emergency was cleared or cancelled (ISO 8601, UTC); null while active.

startRequest.description: Body of POST /api/emergencies (proposed). Operator or Admin only.

emergencyUpdate.description: Payload of the emergency_update socket event (proposed), sent when an emergency starts or moves to the next intersection.

emergencyCleared.description: Payload of the emergency_cleared socket event (proposed), sent when an emergency is cleared or cancelled.
